label: preparing
what: A private evening gathering/hospitality event in the great hall, with refreshments including 200 loaves and hall lighting; its fuller purpose is not disclosed to me. Builder and innkeeper are named for the lighting inspection/meeting, while innkeeper says he is coordinating evening refreshments with builder and freight. Baker supplied the bread; secretary and neighbour helped with logistics/rescue, but there's no evidence they knowingly planned the gathering itself.
